digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The day closed with the Attorney Review sequence approved for an October 19 rollout, while Amazon Connect launch controls and several portfolio decisions moved forward. The main remaining pressure is Legal review capacity for the EKM script queue, now estimated at 274 items and about 69 review hours.

items.detail: The launch-control follow-through for Denver is marked complete.

items.label: Converted stalled portfolio dependencies into decisions
items.detail: The open leadership dependencies were moved to completion today.

items.label: Resolved Skye Austin's document edit requests
items.detail: The four pending case-deck access requests were completed.

items.label: Confirm the NTA SMS production result and release ready work
items.detail: Verify whether the business-hours production test succeeded and whether the NTA communication deployment moved forward. Keep the production-ready CoE request independent if SMS follow-up remains.

items.label: Secure Legal review capacity for EKM scripts
items.detail: No Legal review has started. Leo and Chelsea are expected to be the main reviewers, and the current estimate is 274 items requiring about 69 review hours, with the final volume still subject to script normalization.

items.detail: Verify whether a late Q3 Legacy Award nomination is still possible, confirm timecards are approved, and complete or resolve the overdue harassment-prevention course.

items.label: Close the Legal Request Tool notification gap
items.detail: Confirm whether the incomplete live-tool email is a configuration issue or expected behavior, and route a Halo defect if required information is still missing.

items.label: Plan the five downward reviews
items.detail: All five reviews are due October 15. Reserve writing time and collect prior-manager input where needed.

items.label: Confirm the weekly CoE and Product cadence
items.detail: A CoE and Product touchpoint invite was sent today; confirm the recurring Tuesday cadence is in place for backlog prioritization.

items.label: Triage the newly assigned intake work
items.detail: Review the Universal Intake Questions revamp and Do Not Contact Banners requests, then set the owner, priority, and first follow-up for each.

items.label: Decide Tomas Aparicio's SOP access request
items.detail: Confirm the appropriate permission level for the SOP FP Received document, then approve or decline the request.

items.label: Tudo Bem weekly meeting was canceled and rescheduled

items.label: Attorney Review will follow client interest and move to October 19
items.detail: Final approval sets the sequence as preliminary intake assessment and fee discussion, client confirmation of interest, then attorney review before the engagement letter is signed or payment is collected. The implementation deadline moved from October 15 to October 19.

items.label: Laura begins PTO Friday
items.detail: Her calendar shows PTO through October 16. Close or reassign dependencies that cannot wait until she returns.

items.detail: Use the checkpoint to confirm readiness for Monday's Denver retest and the October 13 go-live. The Salesforce Program Standup at the same time was canceled.

items.detail: EPMO Management begins at 1:00 PM, followed by the pipeline sync at 2:30 PM, the rescheduled team meeting at 3:00 PM, and the executive slide update at 3:30 PM.

items.detail: The two back-to-back calls need clear ownership, priority, and downstream dependency decisions.
